Each cut face shows a bright blue water band over an ochre earth stratum; the interface between them is ragged, not level. Water band is ~0.3 of thickness.
A continuous white foam band hugs every land/water boundary including the rock islets, with a turquoise shallow band immediately outside it.
Rectilinear farm parcels in alternating green, olive and wheat-tan, with hard straight boundaries, tiled over the flat plateau tops only.
Plateau risers are near-vertical grey-violet rock with vertical fluting and darker cavity lines; grass caps the lip with a hard edge.
Snow covers the summit and reaches down the gullies in tongues; the snowline is irregular and follows drainage, not a level contour.
A large upright stone annulus standing on the NW plateau, weathered grey, broken at the base, roughly one eighth of the island width in diameter.
A stone bridge of repeated round arches on piers spans the central strait, deck flat, abutments socketed into both banks.
A white waterfall drops the full height of the west cliff into the sea, widening slightly toward the base with a spray disc where it lands.
A white-towered windmill with a red conical cap and four lattice sails stands among a cluster of ~8 red-roofed houses on the east field plateau.
A cream-walled castle on a rock islet, with several cylindrical towers capped by red-orange cones of differing heights.
Small rock stacks stand in open water, each carrying one or two conifers and ringed by its own foam collar.
Opaque white cumulus masses float at and BELOW plateau height, over the sea and against the mountain flanks - inside the diorama, not a distant sky. Thin cirrus streaks cross the summit horizontally.
Tan dirt paths wind between hamlets and along plateau tops, narrow and irregular, distinct from the straight field boundaries.
A pale cream sand band lies between lowland grass and the foam line wherever the coast is low; absent wherever a cliff meets the water directly.

Rear-right highland is ARID ochre sandstone, stepped into terraces with visible horizontal strata, green vegetation only on its lower slopes. It is a distinct biome from the green lowland, not the same rock in another colour.

Two grey cylindrical stone watchtowers stand on the mesa top with a short ruined wall run between them. Corrects an earlier reading of "fortress": the targeted crop shows separate towers, not a walled keep.
White cylindrical lighthouse with a red conical cap and a dark gallery band below the lantern, standing on a green-capped cliff islet.
A timber jetty on posts runs out from the east village shore into shallow water, decking visible as thin planks.
